name: Ateba Abega Gautier
summary: A 24-year-old, 6-foot-4 knockout puncher with an 81-inch reach: 5-0 in the UFC, four by knockout. The one test that went long, Andrey Pulyaev in January, was a grind he won on the cards.

how_they_fight.Striking: Big, powerful and increasingly composed; finishes with punches in combination once he's hurt someone.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Hard to take down (stops about 82%); size makes him hard to hold.
how_they_fight.Defense: The Pulyaev fight showed he can be frustrated at range by a durable, lanky opponent.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Unproven in hard three-round fights beyond Pulyaev.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Still developing; a UFC.com feature calls him 'a changed man' two years on, more patient than in his early career.

patterns: Uses size to push opponents back
concerns: Can be made to work at range
keys_to_beat: Wrestle him and make him carry weight
Stay durable and drag him into round three
